regions.today: Today will start mostly cloudy but some sunny spells will develop as the day goes on. Highest temperatures of 19 to 24 degrees, warmest in the south, with a light to moderate west to northwest breeze.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight with a mix of cloud and clear spells. Lowest temperatures of 12 to 15 degrees in light to moderate westerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will start out bright before cloud builds from the west with scattered outbreaks of light rain or drizzle possible through the afternoon and evening. A cooler day with highest temperatures of 16 to 21 degrees. Breezier than recent days with a moderate and occasionally fresh westerly wind.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high on Friday and low on Saturday.
